analysis_scope: One selected V214 logical 4096-token target+MTP chunk only; not a full 32K prompt occupancy profile

device_memcpy_activity.interpretation: CUPTI MEMCPY activity duration/bytes are reported separately from host runtime API intervals.

interpretation_limits: Per-device kernel union removes overlap among kernels on that device.
Six-GPU concurrency is a sweep over the six per-device kernel unions, not a count of kernel records.
Kernel duration sums may exceed window wall time and are not busy percentages.
Runtime API host duration and device memcpy duration are separate measurements.
No host scheduler, driver API, or CUPTI OSRT activity is inferred.

any_thread_api_vs_any_gpu_kernel_union.interpretation: Temporal interval comparison only; API activity does not establish a host stall or causal GPU wait.

runtime_api_host_time.interpretation: CUPTI runtime API intervals are host API durations; they are not device memcpy durations or GPU busy time.
